from pathlib import Path
import hydra
print('workspace import:', hydra.__file__)
assert Path(hydra.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve())
from hydra._internal.callbacks import Callbacks
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
seen=[]
class Recorder:
    def __init__(self,name):self.name=name
    def on_run_start(self,**kwargs):seen.append(("start",self.name))
    def on_run_end(self,**kwargs):seen.append(("end",self.name))
callbacks=object.__new__(Callbacks);callbacks.callbacks=[Recorder("one"),Recorder("two")]
callbacks.on_run_start(OmegaConf.create({}));callbacks.on_run_end(OmegaConf.create({}))
print(seen)
assert seen==[("start","one"),("start","two"),("end","two"),("end","one")]
